title: My Flashcards
text:
I have flashcards. They are small cards. I write a word on one side. I draw a picture on the other side.

Every day I look at my cards. I read the words aloud. My sister likes my cards too. We play a game together.

questions.text: What do I write on one side of the card?
Why does the writer look at the cards every day?
How does the writer feel about the cards?
options: The writer is angry with them.
The writer is tired of them.

vocabulary.definition: small pieces of stiff paper used for writing or games
units of language that have a meaning
a girl or woman who has the same parents as you

paragraph_translations: Tengo tarjetas de estudio. Son tarjetas pequeñas. Escribo una palabra en un lado. Dibujo una imagen en el otro lado.
Todos los días miro mis tarjetas. Leo las palabras en voz alta. A mi hermana también le gustan mis tarjetas. Jugamos juntas a un juego.
